ai_technology: Nested-CV LASSO survival learning; comparison of45 algorithm combinations

evidence.ai_role: Training-only learned survival selection includes KLF2/NT5E and organizes downstream tissue and functional investigation; no claim that AI alone identified causality.
evidence.tested: New primaryCAF perturbation and CD73-rescue/co-culture experiments with3 patient donors;60 paired tissue mIF samples use a proxy; external survival analyses are retrospective.
evidence.unknown: No clinical intervention benefit; mIF proxy contains KLF2/CD73 and is not independent validation of the full learned score. Single-sample spatial analysis; DFS and fixed-cutoff portability failures.

organization: Hainan Medical University; Hainan General Hospital

source_review.scope: Primary full manuscript Methods, Results, validation protocol and limitations independently reviewed.

summary: A preprint compared 45 survival-learning combinations in 439 colorectal-cancer training cases and selected a 17-gene LASSO signature including KLF2 and NT5E/CD73. Follow-on experiments using fibroblasts from three patients found that KLF2 overexpression reduced CD8 T-cell killing in co-culture, while KLF2 knockdown or CD73 inhibition reversed this effect. Tissue imaging used a four-protein proxy, not the transcriptomic score itself. Prognostic associations varied by endpoint and fixed-threshold transfer failed in external cohorts. This is a bounded cell-culture result, without proven patient treatment benefit.
title: Survival learning links a fibroblast signature to a tested KLF2–CD73 pathway
